description: This file defines a React functional component named 'Toast' that displays notification messages with configurable types ('info', 'success', 'warning', 'error'), positions, auto-dismiss behavior, and accessibility features. It includes styling, logic for auto-dismiss via useEffect, and handles rendering of message content with icons and optional close button.

methods.name: Toast
methods.description: React functional component for showing toast notifications with auto-dismissal and positioning options.
